description: Checks a size chart and reports what is wrong with it or still unanswered, without changing it. Takes a size chart, never a person's measurements. Limits: one call per request; up to 60 sizes, 40 columns or measurements a size, and 64 characters a size label or measurement name; each table cell is read up to 200 characters. Send a chart in SizeRef chart format v1, or a table as html, csv, or headers and rows. variant_sizes compares the chart's size labels with the product's; product_title decides whether hips are kept for long tops such as a kurta or a dress; product_text gives the fit when the table does not state it. results[] holds one result per table found; the top-level verdict is the worst table's, so read results[] for each table. It cannot see the product page, so a pasted table is at best needs_fix until normalise_size_chart gets the answers.
name: audit_size_chart
title: Audit a size chart
